neighbours.label: 'data', 'information' or 'numbers' used as a noun modifier in a compound (data sets, information technology, a numbers game)
fire: We merged the three climate data sets into one table.
He took a job in information technology after college.
Winning elections is ultimately a numbers game.
The lab hired two new data analysts this spring.
Please contact the information desk on the ground floor.
She wrote a data pipeline for the survey results.
The ministry is the official data source for these figures.
Our data center in Ohio lost power overnight.
quiet: We merged the three climate models into one table.
He took a job in software engineering after college.
Winning elections is ultimately a hard game.
The lab hired two new research analysts this spring.
Please contact the front desk on the ground floor.
She wrote a script for the survey results.
The ministry is the official source for these figures.
Our server room in Ohio lost power overnight.

notes: the - pole is the same nouns as heads ('something', 'things', 'information'); + pole = modifier position
